title: Route of the first carnival tour
summary: They went as far north as Indianapolis and played Kentucky and Tennessee towns, Roanoke and elsewhere.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Was this in the first tour? The first carnival tour?
The one from April to November of '24?
Let me see the first one, the carnival tour...
That's all I'm trying to ask you about right now, because we'll get to the other stuff later.
Yeah. Well, the first carnival tour, we went to... Let's see, as far north as we went was Indianapolis.
Where did you mainly tour? You ended up in Florida, right?
What places did you cover on that tour, from April to November?
Well, we played... Like, sent down to Kentucky to them little small towns. Lexington, Kentucky. Bowling Green, Kentucky. Knoxville, Tennessee. Chattanooga, Tennessee. Roanoke, Virginia.
This was on that first tour?
